description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
As a critical member of the Customer Experience Strategy team, you will focus on advancing our mission of delivering a superior experience throughout the customers' end-to-end journey. You will play a pivotal role in improving our customers' experience, loyalty and growth by influencing the company and our leadership to action using customer experience feedback and insights, increasingly powered by AI-driven signal analysis. This role reports directly to the Head of CX Strategy.

You understand that AI is changing how companies listen to, understand, and act on customer feedback, and you're excited to bring that thinking into how we run our listening programs. You will partner with leaders across the organization to execute new customer listening programs and provide a more holistic, increasingly real-time voice of customer assessment for Samsara .

You will also come ready to dive deep into customer journeys and data - using both traditional analysis including customer visits and interviews, and emerging AI tools like LLM-based theme extraction and AI-inferred sentiment analysis - to understand and empathize with customer pain points and identify opportunities with respect to customer engagement, business strategy, and quality of service.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

•
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (Zuora)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Drive the strategic evolution of Everpure’s enterprise quote-to-cash ecosystem as a Senior Salesforce Developer. In this role, you will architect, build, and optimize complex Salesforce and Zuora Billing/CPQ solutions that accelerate our revenue operations and eliminate business bottlenecks. You will solve variable technical challenges, design robust APIs, and partner directly with cross-functional leaders in Finance, Sales Operations, and IT to deliver seamless subscription and billing processes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Architect Scalable Quote-to-Cash Workflows: Design, code, and deploy custom Apex, Lightning Web Components, and automated flows on the Everpure Platform to optimize quote creation, product rate plans, subscriptions, and billing renewals.

• Drive Strategic Enterprise Integrations: Build and maintain high-performance REST/SOAP API integrations and AppExchange connections between Salesforce, Zuora, and enterprise systems to ensure fault-tolerant data synchronization and security.

• Optimize Operational Efficiency & System Health: Identify process bottlenecks, perform root-cause debugging, monitor performance metrics, and participate in production support to ensure high availability and seamless data integrity across ecosystem solutions.

• Lead Modern Engineering Practices: Establish best practices for change management, GitHub version control, deployment pipelines, and the utilization of AI-assisted coding tools to elevate engineering quality across the team.

• Advanced Technical Mastery: Extensive expertise in Salesforce architecture and programmatic development (Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Web Services/oAuth) paired with deep hands-on experience configuring Zuora Billing, Zuora Quotes/CPQ, and enterprise quote-to-cash business logic.

• Complex Problem-Solving & Innovation: Ability to evaluate complex architectural requirements, select effective declarative or programmatic methods, and translate strategic business goals into secure, scalable technical designs.

• Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration: Strong analytical, communication, and consultative skills with a track record of partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, driving consensus, and guiding technical execution.

• Modern Development Tooling Proficiency: Direct experience utilizing version control systems (such as GitHub), CI/CD release management practices, and modern AI-assisted coding tools to deliver quality software efficiently.

title: ESG & Environmental and Social Management Consultant (C-26-14)
description:
This is a remote position.
The International Potato Center (CIP) is strengthening its institutional approach to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) and Environmental and Social Management (ESM), appropriate to its mandate as an international agricultural research organization, its decentralized operating model, and the environmental and social risks associated with its research, operations, projects, partnerships and field activities.
Benchmarking with other CGIAR Centers and the CGIAR System Organization indicates ESG should not be treated solely as a sustainability reporting exercise: a credible approach also requires mechanisms to identify, assess, manage, monitor and evidence environmental and social risks across the organization and project lifecycle.CIP's approach therefore spans two complementary dimensions:

• Institutional ESG and sustainability - CIP's own environmental, social and governance responsibilities and performance; and

• Project-level environmental and social safeguards - risks and impacts associated with research, projects, field activities, partners, suppliers and communities.

CIP intends to build on its existing governance, enterprise risk management, project management, partner management and internal control arrangements, rather than establish a separate ESG structure. At the same time, CIP wishes to: become ready to demonstrate alignment with ISO 14001; establish a credible and proportionate ESG framework; strengthen safeguards to meet Green Climate Fund (GCF) and comparable climate-finance requirements; understand GCF requirements beyond ISO 14001; understand how far existing fiduciary and institutional systems already support GCF readiness; and build a baseline that responds efficiently to other donors
Objective:
The purpose of the consultancy is to establish where CIP is today; what target ESG and Environmental & Social Management architecture is appropriate for CIP; what gaps exist against ISO, GCF and relevant donor expectations; and what practical, proportionate steps CIP should take to close them.
The assignment is structured as three sequential phases. Phase 1 is scoped as a self-contained diagnostic and policy engagement that CIP can commission and complete on its own. Phases 2 and 3 build on Phase 1's findings and are intended to be scoped in detail - and commissioned - once Phase 1 is complete, so that their design reflects what the baseline and gap analysis actually show, rather than being fixed in advance.
This consultancy advertisement is for Phase 1 only. Phases 2 and 3 are indicative future phases and will be scoped and commissioned separately based on the findings of Phase 1.
The consultant should havedemonstrated experience assessing and designing ESG and environmental and social management frameworks in international or decentralized organizations. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in ISO 14001, environmental and social safeguards and climate-finance requirements with the ability to translate international standards into practical and proportionate institutional arrangements.
Deliverables:
Phase 1 - Diagnose and Frame (4-6 weeks)
Establish where CIP stands today against ISO 14001, institutional ESG maturity, GCF environmental and social safeguards readiness, and broader donor requirements. Deliver a validated current-state and maturity assessment, an integrated gap analysis, a draft CIP ESG/Environmental and Social Management Policy, and a management briefing with recommendations on Phase 2/3 scope and sequencing. Phase 1 is a self-contained engagement that CIP can act independently. See Annex A for the full topic taxonomy: environmental, social and governance sub-areas).
Phase 1 Deliverables

• D1.1 - Inception Report and Requirements Crosswalk

• D1.2 - CIP Current-State and Maturity Assessment

• D1.3 - Integrated Gap Analysis (ISO / ESG / GCF safeguards / broader GCF institutional map / other donors)

• D1.4 - Draft CIP ESG / Environmental & Social M

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the business in meeting its regulatory obligations and managing enterprise risk.

The Product Compliance team is responsible for embedding compliance into the product lifecycle and supporting the compliant development, launch and ongoing operation of OKX products and features globally across all markets in which our products and services are offered. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to identify regulatory and compliance requirements, assess product risks and develop practical solutions that support responsible commercial growth.

About the Opportunity

 We are seeking an experienced, hands-on and commercially minded Senior Compliance Manager to join our Product Compliance team.
This is a senior individual-contributor role focused primarily on the day-to-day review of new products, material product changes and existing product enhancements. The emphasis is on delivering timely, well-reasoned product compliance assessments using a risk-based approach, ensuring that material compliance risks are sufficiently mitigated and the firm’s regulatory positioning protected.

You will act as a trusted compliance partner throughout the product development lifecycle, helping Product and Engineering teams navigate complex regulatory requirements while enabling commercially viable outcomes. You will be expected to distinguish between legal or regulatory constraints that cannot be crossed, risks that can be addressed through proportionate controls, and residual risks that require documented escalation or risk acceptance.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

•

• Own and deliver day-to-day compliance reviews of new products, features, market expansions and material changes to existing products across OKX's global business and product suite.

• Review product requirements, technical documentation, user journeys, onboarding flows, trading or transaction mechanics, reward structures, disclosures and operational processes.

• Apply a risk-based waterfall that distinguishes hard legal or regulatory blockers from risks that may be addressed through controls, product conditions, jurisdictional restrictions, monitoring or escalation.

• Conduct and document product compliance risk assessments covering areas such as regulatory perimeter and licensing, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions, trading and market conduct, asset safeguarding, data privacy and third-party risk.

• Produce clear, concise and evidence-based and solutions-based compliance recommendations setting out identified risks, required mitigants, residual exposure and the proposed approval or escalation route.

• Work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to develop practical and scalable solutions to identified compliance requirements.

• Maintain complete and accurate documentation and audit trails for product reviews, decisions, conditions, exceptions, approvals

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.
Position Title: Commissioning Project Manager
Position Location: Remote - United States. Must be located near a major airport.
Travel Requirements: Up to 50% domestic travel. Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.
JOB SUMMARY
The Commissioning Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems.
The Commissioning Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.
The role may assist with developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws, and specifications.
This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, client staff and the DLB commissioning team to test, validate and make operational newly installed and operational electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities.
The Commissioning Project Manager will receive limited directions on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute commissioning and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.
This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)

• Assist with pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals

• Coordinate and support resource and material forecasting

• Develop, manage and monitor schedule

• Participate in, schedule or lead project meetings

Advantmed is a healthcare services company headquartered in Irvine, California, serving primarily health plans that participate in government-sponsored programs. The Company operates three lines of business: medical record retrieval; medical record review and coding; and in-home health assessments. Together these support health plans across risk adjustment, HEDIS, quality reporting, and member care - with a substantial delivery organization in Ahmedabad, India supporting the U.S. operation.
In-home health assessments are the Company’s newest line of business and its fastest growing. description:
At LendingPoint , we believe that everyone deserves to feel the power of possibilities. As an online fintech company, we’ve created advanced consumer, small business, and merchant point-of-sale lending solutions to unlock access to affordable loans and empower those working to build their financial potential. By creating technology that sees your potential, we’re driving a better lending and borrowing experience by finding more reasons to say “yes.”

• Team Oriented Fast-Paced Fun Environment

• Dedicated and experienced Management Team

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy models into production environment.

• Work with stakeholders throughout the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging company data to drive business solutions.

• Optimize complex SQL programs for speed and efficiency.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Finance, etc.). Master’s / PhD degree preferred.

• 4+ years’ experience in fintech or financial services applying advanced statistical and machine learning predictive techniques.

• Expert knowledge in statistical programming languages such as Python, R, and database languages such as SQL

• Knowledge of advanced statistical modeling, testing, data mining, ETL, and data science techniques.

• Experience using GCP and/or Hadoop systems for distributed analytics and data processing.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work in fast-paced environment.

title: Scrum Master
description:
What is the position?

As a Scrum Master, you love contributing to the in-depth growth of development teams brought together for our clients. You will focus on the agile process of the team, support this process by making it more efficient and improving collaboration. In a nutshell, your most important task is to facilitate a good development process of the team. You enthuse the team to follow specific methodologies and solve any roadblocks the team encounters within their process. You also coach the team in their agile abilities and answer any process related questions from both the team as well as other stakeholders.

What are you going to do?

You will be part of a young and growing organization that aims to develop the best cross-platform mobile apps out there. As a Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for creating a team spirit within a group of developers. You’ll act as a link between our developers, clients and third parties and keep the focus on the end goal. In addition, you’ll ensure that you will keep an open attitude but remain critical to make sure requirements are met for the customer while keeping everyone informed on project progress, status, schedule, deadlines, and releases.

You’ll be transparent and open about the choices made and to be made. You’ll know the ins and outs of the market and translate this into user stories. You’ll also be realistic and pragmatic and willing to cooperate.

Who are we looking for?

For this position, we are looking for someone who has very strong communication skills, experience with a role as a Scrum Master in an Agile work environment and an interest in the world of app development.

Ideally, you have some (Xamaring, C#, .NET) programming experience and you have at least two years’ experience in a comparable position. A PSM II certification is a big plus! You should also be aware of the ins and outs of the market and be able to translate this to user stories. Last but not least, you have a completed Masters Degree or equivalent.

Who is XABLU?

XABLU is a leader in cross-platform mobile app development and consultancy. From boosting our clients’ development teams to helping them refine their mobile strategy: we are there to support them with all of their app development needs. In addition, we host events where developers can talk about technology, hack and socialize. We are known for our deep expertise in the Microsoft Xamarin mobile ecosystem as well as our signature friendly and efficient team approach.

We also have internal projects we are developing: one is a user-centered platform combined with blockchain, and the other is a platform with a lot of automation challenges!

XABLU is a remote-first company: team and communication are our top priority and we embrace different cultures as well as different geo-locations. At XABLU, you’ll be working in an environment where you can express your talents, ideas and personality. You’ll be pushed by your colleagues to develop yourself and the team in an informal and fun atmosphere.

Your Profile

• Experience with a role as Scrum Master

• Strong communication skills

• Interest in app development

• Enjoy managing people and projects

• Good at prioritizing and planning

• Ideally, programming experience

• Completed Master Degree or equivalent

• Prefarably having PSM II certification or willing to obtain it

• Used to working with a team and to build up dynamics

• Available for 32-40 hours per week

title: Senior Coatings & Corrosion Consultant
description:
Structural Integrity Associates (SIA) is seeking a Senior Coatings & Corrosion Consultant to help build and grow our coatings and linings service offerings within the nuclear power industry. This position may be based remotely or in one of our office locations.

This role combines technical execution, client engagement, and business development. The selected candidate will support existing coating-related work while playing a key role in expanding SIA’s presence in areas such as internal linings, protective coatings, and corrosion mitigation strategies for critical plant assets.

This is a high-visibility, growth-oriented role with the opportunity to shape a developing service line and directly influence its long-term success. The position will also support research and development (R&D) programs, field applications, and technical consulting for clients.

The work environment within SIA is highly collaborative, leveraging expertise across Structural Integrity (e.g., Materials, Chemistry, Vibration, Advanced Reactors) to deliver solutions that enhance component reliability, extend service life, and improve safety.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Lead and support coating and linings projects for nuclear plant systems involving coating selection, qualification, performance assessment, and application for nuclear and industrial applications

• Lead or support commercial grade dedication (CGD) of coatings and lining systems, including identification of critical characteristics, development of dedication plans, supplier evaluation, and ensuring compliance with 10 CFR 50 Appendix B quality assurance requirements

• Develop technical scopes of work, specifications, and inspection plans

• Evaluate coating degradation, failure mechanisms, and life extension strategies

• Support field activities including contractor oversight and QA

• Interface with clients to identify needs and develop follow-on work

• Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities, developing proposals and engaging with clients

• Collaborate internally to cross sell SI offerings, bundle services, and expand scope

• Develop standardized approaches and best practices

• Author and review technical reports, test plans, and client deliverables

• Engage in client consulting, troubleshooting, and field application support

Required Skills/Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Materials Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5-15+ years in coatings, corrosion, linings, or asset integrity

• Direct experience supporting commercial grade dedication (CGD) of materials or components and working within 10 CFR 50 Appendix B nuclear quality assurance programs

• Experience in specification, inspection, assessment, or rehabilitation

• Strong client-facing and communication skills

• Ability to support business development activities

• Excellent communication and technical writing skills

• Ability to travel (~15-30%) to support client projects, testing, and business development

• Ability to obtain Nuclear Unescorted Access Authorization (UAA) as required

Desired Skills/Qualifications:

• >10 years of experience in the Nuclear Industry or similar field

• Experience with coatings and polymers under extreme service environments (radiation, high temperature, corrosive media)

• Direct experience collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams

• Familiarity with Nuclear Industry materials challenges (e.g., degradation, life extension, advanced reactor applications)

• Familiarity of standards and testing protocols for nuclear and industrial coatings, such as ASTM (including Committee D33), AMPP/NACE, SSPC surface preparation standards, AWWA coating standards, and applicable nuclear requirements (e.g., 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, EPRI guidance, LR/SLR activities).

• Familiarity with internal linings, tanks, buried piping, or AWWA systems

• AMPP/NACE CIP certification

title: Startup Partnerships Associate
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex
Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do
As a Startups Ambassador at Brex, you’ll be the face of our brand in the startup ecosystem by building trusted relationships with top-tier VC's and high-growth founders. You’ll represent Brex in the market by hosting events, driving engagement, and creating meaningful connections that bring value to the startup community.

Your main focus will be to grow Brex’s presence within key venture networks by establishing and deepening partnerships, acquiring new customers, and fostering a strong local community. Success will be measured by your ability to bring in new startups, expand Brex’s market share among top partners, develop new channel relationships, and deliver high-quality experiences that strengthen Brex’s position within the startup space.

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. title: Copier Account Executive - Northeast
description:

Canon USA is seeking a Copier Account Executive - East Coast (Executive, Account). The Copier Account Executive position involves developing strategies to increase sales with key decision-makers in the Dealer Sales Channel and end users, promoting strong business relationships with assigned dealers and their respective branches while maintaining the highest ethical standards. The role requires effective communication with Fortune 500 level executives-including CEOs, CIOs, and CFOs-to present high-level sales strategies, ROI analyses, and technical workflow solutions, as well as providing technical expertise to assist dealers and customers in selecting hardware and software solutions. Additional responsibilities include managing dealer accounts and territories, coordinating product launches and updates, organizing events and tradeshows, and applying professional expertise to resolve routine issues within company policies. The candidate must live near a major US airport within the Northeast region. This position is full time and is considered virtual. The office will be open 5 days a week; however you will not be required to report to the office unless there is a specific business need.  Note that work schedules and office reporting requirements may change from time to time based on business needs. Your Impact
- Develop strategies to increase Sales with key decision makers in the Dealer Sales Channel and with End User Promotes the business relationship between company and Assigned Dealers and/or Offices - Communicates effectively with Fortune 500 Customers including CEO, CIO, and CFO's presenting High Level Sales Strategies, ROI, and Technical Workflow analysis - Assists the Dealer Sales Channel and End User Customers with technical knowledge that allows for detailed analysis and recommended hardware and software solutions - Manages Dealer Sales Channel account accounts, territories, marketing program implementation, education, and other Channel related support - Conducts High Level Introductory Sales Calls. Provides Retail Sales Channel proposal development and bid support assistance - Coordinates and implements product launches and equipment/software updates with Dealer Sales Channel - Manages coordinator of certain events/tradeshows - Mid-level position where decisions are made within established policies and standard practices - Possesses specialized knowledge or skills in a particular functional area - Learns to use professional concepts - Applies company policies and procedures to resolve routine issues - Has working knowledge of company products and services - Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues About You: The Skills & Expertise You Bring
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required, plus 3-5 years of related experience - Experience with copier sales / A3 market is required - B2B retail sales and/or customer face to face, copier dealer, copier manufacturer experience preferred - Experience selling directly to end users is required - CompTIA CDIA/CDIA+ Certification is a plus - CompTIA Network+ Certification is a plus - 5+ years in sales/sales support and industry related experience - Travel of over 75% or more in the assigned region is expected for this position - This position works remotely from a home office located near a major metropolitan city/airport and requires overnight travel - Individual must possess a clean valid state driver's license in order to obtain the position - This position requires driving, therefore a valid driver's license and acceptable driving record are necessary. title: Production Specialist
description:
Be Part of What’s Next
Bring a Trailer is where passion for cars meets storytelling and community. As a Production Specialist, you’ll play a key role in shaping how standout vehicles are presented to an engaged global audience-guiding sellers from submission to a successful auction experience.
About Hearst Magazines (Why Us?)
Hearst Magazines’ portfolio of more than 30 powerful brands in the U.S. reaches more than 165 million people every month across print, digital, video, and social platforms. The company’s diverse portfolio includes many of the world’s most iconic and trusted media brands, including Cosmopolitan, ELLE, Esquire, Good Housekeeping, Harper’s BAZAAR, Popular Mechanics, and Runner’s World, as well as enthusiast titles like Car and Driver and Road & Track.
Key Responsibilities (What You Are Doing)

• Prepare auction listings by organizing seller-submitted data and photos in accordance with Bring a Trailer standards

• Coordinate with sellers and internal teams to incorporate updates and ensure listing accuracy and completeness

• Serve as the primary point of contact for sellers during the pre-auction phase, delivering timely and professional communication

• Provide high-quality customer support by answering questions, offering guidance, and addressing concerns with empathy

• Manage and prioritize a high-volume pipeline of listings at various stages to meet daily production goals

• Track listings through internal systems and act as the subject matter expert on each listing’s history

• Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a smooth transition from listing creation to auction launch

• Contribute to special projects and process improvements as needed

Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

• 2+ years of experience in customer support, content production, technical writing, automotive services, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• Strong writing and editing skills with an ability to present detailed information clearly and accurately

• Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first mindset and a professional, approachable communication style

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and build trust with stakeholders

• Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges independently while knowing when to escalate

• Interest in or knowledge of collector cars and automotive culture; hands-on automotive experience is a plus

• Adaptable, proactive, and eager to support evolving team and business needs

This is a full-time position that can be done remotely. Please note that we can only consider applicants from the following states: CA, CO, DE, FL, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, WI.
Benefits (What We Offer)

• Work with the Best: Collaborate with top-tier professionals across media, advertising, tech, fashion, lifestyle, and publishing, shaping the future of these dynamic industries.

• Grow Your Skills : Unlock your potential with access to innovative training programs, immersive workshops, and exclusive industry events.

• Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid work, empowering you to balance professional success with personal priorities.

• Foster Connection & Belonging: Join our Employee Resource Groups and help create a welcoming workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered.

• Wellness First: Prioritize your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance from Day 1.

• Plan for Your Financial Future : Enjoy competitive financial perks, including a 401(k) plan with a generous company match.

The base salary for this role is $66,000-$70,000. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified
